scenario.title: 跟房東或仲介看房子
scenario.context: 看房時要一邊聽介紹、一邊問問題：有沒有洗衣機、有沒有電梯、附近有什麼。這整個單元都在描述「某處有什麼」，也就是台灣人最容易講錯的 There is / There are。

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.en: So this is the studio. It's about ten ping, so it's a bit of a shoebox, but it's got great light.
lines.zh: 這就是那間套房，大概十坪，有點小，但採光很好。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It's cozy. Is there a washing machine?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.en: There's one on the rooftop that all the tenants share.
lines.zh: 頂樓有一台，所有房客共用。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hmm, that's a bit of a hassle. Are there any units with their own washer?
lines.zh: 嗯，那有點麻煩。有自己洗衣機的房間嗎？

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.en: There's a bigger one on the fourth floor, but it's three thousand more a month.
lines.zh: 四樓有一間比較大的，但每個月貴三千。

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.en: Unfortunately, no. But there are lots of restaurants and a supermarket right downstairs.
lines.zh: 可惜沒有。不過樓下有很多餐廳和一間超市。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: OK. Can I see the fourth-floor one too?
lines.zh: 好。我也可以看四樓那間嗎？

dialogues.title: Talking it over with a friend

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: The first place was a dump, honestly. There was mold all over the bathroom ceiling.
lines.zh: 說真的第一間很破，浴室天花板都是霉。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Gross. What about the second one?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Much better. There are two bedrooms, so I'm thinking of finding a roomie.
lines.zh: 好很多。有兩間房，所以我在想要找個室友。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: A tiny one. There's just enough room for a chair and a plant.
lines.zh: 很小一個，剛好放得下一張椅子和一盆植物。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: That's all you need. I say go for it.
lines.zh: 這樣就夠了。我覺得可以租。

patterns.note: utilities = 水電瓦斯網路等費用
台灣常見押二付一：a two-month deposit plus one month's rent

patterns.en: Can I think about it and get back to you?
patterns.zh: 我可以考慮一下再回覆你嗎？

chinglish.wrong: There have a washing machine on the roof.
chinglish.right: There's a washing machine on the roof.
chinglish.why: 中文「有」同時表示擁有和存在。表示「某地有某物」要用 There is / There are，不能用 have。

chinglish.wrong: This room has very good sunshine.
chinglish.why: sunshine 指陽光本身。說房子採光好，英文慣用 get a lot of light / get great light。

chinglish.wrong: The rent is include water and electricity?
chinglish.why: include 是動詞，不能和 is 疊在一起。問句用 Does… include…?

chinglish.wrong: The house is very small but very warm.
chinglish.why: warm 形容房子多半是溫度。「溫馨」要用 cozy。

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.oneLiner: 要說「某個地方有某樣東西」，用 There is / There are，不用 have。
whenToUse: There is + 單數或不可數名詞：There's a supermarket downstairs. / There's mold on the ceiling.
There are + 複數名詞：There are two bedrooms.
問句：Is there…? / Are there any…?
否定：There isn't a… / There aren't any…
過去：There was / There were。未來：There will be / There's going to be。
have 是「某人擁有」：The apartment has two bedrooms 也對，因為主詞是房子；但不能說 There have。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「有」一個字身兼兩職：「我有車」（擁有）和「樓下有超市」（存在）。英文把這兩件事分得很清楚：擁有用 have，存在用 there is/are。台灣人會直翻出 There have…、或 Downstairs has a supermarket，前者文法錯誤，後者聽起來很怪。

examples.correct: There's a convenience store on every corner.
examples.incorrect: There has a convenience store on every corner.

examples.note: 問「附近有沒有」用 Are there any。

examples.correct: The apartment has two bedrooms and a balcony.
examples.note: 以房子為主詞時可以用 has。

examples.correct: There was a lot of noise last night.
examples.incorrect: There were a lot of noise last night.

quiz.explanation: cafés 是複數，用 Are there any。

quiz.question: There ___ two bathrooms in the apartment.
There ___ a lot of traffic this morning.
quiz.explanation: traffic 不可數，過去用 was。

quiz.question: Sorry, there ___ any parking spaces left. (否定)

slang.usage: 朋友間稱呼室友。美式 roommate 通常指同住一間公寓；英式多說 flatmate。

risk.note: 口語暱稱，租屋合約等正式文件寫 roommate / tenant。

examples.en: My roomie and I split the rent fifty-fifty.
examples.zh: 我跟室友房租各付一半。

examples.en: I'm looking for a roomie. Know anyone?
examples.zh: 我在找室友，你有認識誰嗎？

slang.meaning: 破爛的地方、很髒亂的房子
slang.usage: 批評住處或店家又破又髒。This place is a dump.

risk.note: 當著房東或主人的面說非常失禮；自嘲自己家亂沒關係。

examples.en: My first apartment was a total dump, but it was cheap.
examples.zh: 我第一間公寓超破，但很便宜。

examples.en: Sorry, my place is a dump right now. I haven't cleaned in weeks.
examples.zh: 抱歉我家現在超亂，好幾週沒打掃了。

slang.meaning: 超小的房子（鞋盒般大小）
slang.usage: 形容住處小到像鞋盒，大城市租屋族的自嘲。

risk.note: 自嘲自己家很自然；說別人家是 shoebox 要看交情。

examples.en: I pay twenty thousand a month for a shoebox in Da'an.
examples.zh: 我每個月付兩萬住大安區的鞋盒。

examples.en: It's a shoebox, but it's my shoebox.
examples.zh: 雖然很小，但它是我的小窩。

slang.usage: 形容很費工、很煩的事。It's a hassle. / What a hassle. 也可以當動詞 hassle someone（煩某人）。

risk.note: 工作場合也能用，語氣比 annoying 溫和。

examples.en: Carrying laundry up to the roof every week is such a hassle.
examples.zh: 每週把衣服搬上頂樓超麻煩。
